_source: realauction.com/clients — the vendor's own client directory, read 2026-09-15 by posting its filter form for every state and product and paging each result.
_why: Two things it settles. Which counties are on RealAuction at all — 119 outside New Jersey, against the 95 the in-page 'Jump to' selector shows, because that selector omits whichever site you are already on and covers fewer products. And which product a county uses, which is what a capture needs to know before it opens anything: realtaxdeed and realtaxlien sell tax debt, realforeclose is mortgage foreclosure unless the county runs both there.
_caution: The form pages at fifty. A single unpaged POST returns fifty hosts per state and reads as a complete answer — the first pass of this file stopped at New Jersey's letter D and looked finished. Page until a request adds nothing.

_families.realtaxdeed.com: Tax deed sales. Florida, plus Apache/Coconino/Mohave in Arizona.
_families.realtaxlien.com: Tax LIEN sales, all Florida, all suffixed 'fl'. A separate family from realtaxdeed and a separate sale: Florida counties sell liens in spring and deeds year-round.
_families.realforeclose.com: Mortgage foreclosure and sheriff sales, and tax deeds where a county runs both on one host. Also where every non-Florida county outside New Jersey sits, under a state-suffixed subdomain: berks.pa, king.wa, travis.texas, suffolk.ny, kootenai.id, iberville.la.
_families.newjerseytaxsale.com: New Jersey municipal tax lien sales. 246 towns — see docs/nj-taxsale-capture.md.

newjerseytaxsale.com: 246 municipalities; the ones with scheduled sales are already in the auctions table with their exact host in source_url — see docs/nj-taxsale-capture.md for the query.
